item.description: Ransomware is increasingly becoming a democratised tool for cybercriminals, with off-the-shelf kits available for as little as £29 ($40) per month. As a result, the number of attackers has increased, and many are looking further afield for smaller, but attractive, paydays. item.title: Using AI to hire? Don’t skip these three steps
item.description: With British unemployment set to reach a high not seen since 2015, hiring processes are turning into even more of a pressure cooker for job seekers and businesses alike. Faced with a flood of applications for every position, employers are increasingly turning to AI to help speed up the hiring process and find the best candidates for roles. But not all AI hiring tools are created equal. While ethical, explainable AI promises to enhance recruitment, some garden-variety models are making it worse.
